name: footer-blocks

frames.best_why: The full sitemap footer is visible with tagline, newsletter, four link columns and bottom bar.

tagline: Four footer layouts switchable: sitemap, link search, contact and minimal.
summary: One footer component with four layouts. It can show a mega sitemap with region and language pickers, a searchable page index, a contact card with a live clock, or a slim link bar.
appearance: A dark, full-width footer with a brand wordmark and tagline at the top, a four-column sitemap of small headings and links, and a bottom bar of legal links, social marks and two pill selectors. Other variants swap the body for a search field or contact rows.
behaviour: A variant pill changes the whole layout. The sitemap columns rise in as they scroll into view, the link-search footer filters every page as you type, and the contact footer copies rows beside a live clock.
demo_content: Brand Northwind; sections Product, Developers, Resources, Company; tabs Sitemap, Link search, Contact, Minimal.
use_when: A product site wants several footer styles for different page types, all from one import.
avoid_when: You need a tiny single-row footer; the search and contact variants add behaviour and height.
customise: FooterBlocks takes only variant, brand and className; link data comes from kit constants. Use the four exported sub-footers to pass your own columns, links and socials.
weight_why: Static links with small CSS transitions; the search and clock add minor client work.

a11y.note: Strong: nav labels, aria-labelled select inputs and focus rings; the sitemap animation respects reduced motion.

issues: The demo adds its own variant switcher above the footer, which is not part of the component.
Each frame shows only one variant, so search and contact edge states stay unseen.
polish_why: Careful type scale, real routes and tidy bars; the demo switcher sits outside the footer.
title: Footer Blocks
